name: Eric Swalwell
subject: Kristi Noem is a threat to our democracy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swalwell For Congress
body:
Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District.
https://ericswalwell.com [https://ericswalwell.com]
Hey there —

I know you’ve probably seen the disturbing videos of ICE agents violently detaining immigrants — and in some cases, even American citizens. We cannot and must not normalize this.

While the White House and Kristi Noem churn out memes and photo ops to claim they’re “tough on crime,” we know the truth: their actions are not about safety. They are about fear. They are about control. And they are about undermining the very foundation of our democracy. I need your help fighting their injustice.

CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ESCA-14-Email-Aug2025-FR-August?&refcode=E14915-20250826-StopKristiNoem-SB-Immigration&amount=25]

Let’s be clear: Kristi Noem is not protecting our communities — she is threatening them. Every violent detention, every unconstitutional stunt, every attempt to silence dissent is part of a dangerous agenda that divides us, weakens our democracy, and erodes our freedoms.

We’ve seen this playbook before — scapegoating immigrants, attacking marginalized communities, and concentrating power in the hands of the few. It’s cruel, it’s un-American, and it has to stop.

That’s why we are building a grassroots movement strong enough to hold Noem and her MAGA allies accountable. But we can’t do it without you.

Chip in today to help us fight back against Kristi Noem’s attacks on democracy and defend the values this country was built on.

DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ESCA-14-Email-Aug2025-FR-August?&refcode=E14915-20250826-StopKristiNoem-SB-Immigration&amount=25]

Together, we can stop her.

- Eric

Friend,

I know it’s August, but we’re kicking off our Q3 fundraising drive
a month early, because if there’s one thing I’ve learned, it’s
that falling behind pace is never an option.

In early September, our finance team will meet with me to map out our
Q3 push. And I want to walk into that meeting with momentum already on
our side. That means posting a strong number now, not scrambling at
the very end of the quarter.

OUR GOAL THIS QUARTER IS BIG: $200,000 raised from grassroots donors
like you.

AND LET ME BE CLEAR — these goals aren’t about inflating my ego.

National Democrats have Pennsylvania pinned as a must-flip Senate
seat. George Soros and his dark-money network will spend whatever it
takes to unseat me. EVERY DOLLAR WE RAISE IS ABOUT MAKING SURE THIS
SEAT STAYS PROTECTED WHEN THE TIME COMES.
[https://secure.winred.com/mccormick-pa/eom-1-august-jm?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=jm&utm_campaign=20250826_eom1_jm&utm_term=lrm-active]

WHY DOES THAT MATTER? Because this seat holds the power to keep
delivering for Pennsylvanians and the nation.

I promised to help President Trump:

*
Keep fentanyl off our streets by securing the border,

*
To get our economy back on track,

*
And to fight back against the radical Left’s agenda.

I’m doing exactly what I said I would do, and I WOULD LOVE TO
CONTINUE TO HAVE YOUR SUPPORT TO KEEP GOING.
[https://secure.winred.com/mccormick-pa/eom-1-august-jm?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=jm&utm_campaign=20250826_eom1_jm&utm_term=lrm-active]

I'm Dave McCormick. I'm a West Point grad, combat veteran who served
in the 82nd Airbornet, a 7th-generation Pennsylvanian, AND LAST
NOVEMBER I DEFEATED AN ENTRENCHED CAREER POLITICIAN IN THE #1 SWING
STATE OF THE 2024 ELECTION.

I’ve seen firsthand what great leadership looks like. I’ve seen
that even on our worst days, you have to put the needs of others
first.

That’s why I made a promise to come to the Senate and work with
fellow political outsiders like President Trump to shake up
Washington, and I’m working to do that every single day.

Whether it’s securing the border, reducing crime in our cities,
ending the fentanyl epidemic, or bringing down the cost of
living–I’M COMMITTED TO DELIVERING CONCRETE SOLUTIONS TO THE
BIGGEST ISSUES WE FACE.

But in order to get the job done, it’s going to take all hands on
deck. I need every freedom-loving American to help me shake up
Washington. I promise I won't let you down.

_Senator Dave McCormick_

The Senate’s heading back into session. Job one for me? **Protecting Social Security.**

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: Our knees do not bend.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

Last week
in El Paso, I looked out at a crowd of Texans—organizers, volunteers,
neighbors—and I saw something amazing.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/65875?t=1002&akid=240333%2E444211%2Ek7yLvW ]Beto standing at the center of a crowd of supporters in El Paso.

I saw the real center of power in America. Not the people sitting in the
White House. Not the billionaires funding their agenda. Not the Supreme
Court justices doing their bidding.

I saw the power of people standing up to the would-be tyrants who
currently hold power. Trump and his allies are trying to hijack this
country and complete their corrupt, criminal power grab. And right now, we
are the ones who stand in his way.

In Texas, the GOP has redrawn our congressional maps to steal five
additional seats for themselves—not because they earned them, but because
they rigged the system.

And if we fail to win back the House in 2026, we know what’s coming: More
plainclothes federal agents sweeping Americans off the streets without
warrants. More political retribution, targeting anyone who dares to stand
in opposition. A GOP Congress laying out the royal red carpet for a Trump
third term.

This is the road to authoritarianism. And they’ve made it clear—they’ll
rig every rule, redraw every line, and break every norm to get there.

They want us to feel hopeless. Helpless. Like this is inevitable. Like
nothing we do matters. But they are wrong. What these guys still don’t

It’s official: **Donald Trump has endorsed my opponent, MAGA Republican Mike Rogers, in Michigan’s battleground Senate race.**
This isn’t a surprise – Rogers has spent years kissing up to Trump. MAGA megadonors even spent nearly $80 million last year trying to buy a Senate seat for Rogers. And now with Trump’s backing, we know what’s coming: a flood of GOP dark money and billionaire-funded attacks.
**We can fight back, but I need your help.** The deadline to hit our critical $250,000 end-of-month fundraising goal is right around the corner, and we need the resources: _[**Will you rush $5 to help me compete against Rogers’ war chest and keep Michigan blue?**](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/5358?t=3&akid=717%2E49239%2E0uuoQO)_

It’s about flipping the Senate blue and stopping another MAGA loyalist from rubber-stamping Trump’s chaos agenda: gutting Medicaid, raising prices with reckless tariffs, and forcing working families to pay for tax cuts for billionaires.
I’ve spent my career fighting for Michigan – from helping save 200,000 auto jobs during the Great Recession to flipping a red House seat blue and delivering real results for working people. I’m in this race because Michiganders deserve a senator who fights for them, not someone who takes orders from Donald Trump.
**Here's the truth: Polling shows****I’m the Democrat with the best chance to beat Rogers.** GOP operatives even told _The Hill_ __ that __ I’m their **_toughest_** general election opponent. But to keep this lead – and win – I cannot miss this $250,000 end-of-month fundraising goal.

| | **BREAKING/FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
August 27, 2025 **Mississippi Center for Public Policy **
**Wins Prestigious National Award**
##
---
|
---
**_The Mississippi Center for Public Policy Team_**
| **New Orleans, LA – August 27 th, 2025 – **The Mississippi Center for Public Policy (MCPP), Mississippi’s free-market think tank, has been named winner of the Bob Williams Award for _Biggest Home State Win_ at the State Policy Network’s annual conference in New Orleans.

MCPP, alongside Empower MS, has been recognized for playing a pivotal role in eliminating Mississippi’s state income tax.

The award, decided by a vote of state think tanks across the United States, celebrates MCPP’s transformative impact on Mississippi’s economic landscape. “It is an honor to have our peers nationwide acknowledge our efforts to move the dial in Mississippi,” said MCPP CEO Douglas Carswell.

During the acceptance speech, Carswell expressed gratitude to the Mississippi House Speaker, Jason White, and lawmakers who championed conservative principles to make this historic reform possible.

Mississippi is the first state since oil-rich Alaska in 1980 to eliminate its income tax, a landmark achievement driven by MCPP’s advocacy. Over the past five years, MCPP has been instrumental in advancing a series of free-market reforms, including significant labor market deregulation in 2021, flat tax reform in 2022, and pioneering school funding reform in 2024 to pave the way for school choice.

“These free-market reforms are a potent combination, driving growth,” Carswell stated. “In the past five years, our state has experienced more economic growth than in the previous fifteen, positioning Mississippi as one of America’s fastest-growing states.”

Once considered an economic laggard, Mississippi is increasingly becoming a model for growth and opportunity.

**About Mississippi Center for Public Policy**
The Mississippi Center for Public Policy is a non-profit, free market think tank dedicated to advancing policies that promote economic growth, individual liberty, and limited government in Mississippi.

name: Thomas Massie
subject: Friend I only reach out like this when I must
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Thomas Massie for CongressPO BOX 72821 NEWPORT, KY 41072
body:
I wish I were reaching out today with better news.

| | | [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zv2142ns0inoepq1u9hpg9qahkai68dtermnsgtg_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpjmaoj2clh2bs)
---
Friend – I wish I were reaching out today with better news. _I know you don’t hear from me often, so please know that when I make a plea like this, it really is necessary._ The super PAC that pledged to spend their entire war chest to defeat me just spent _**$1 MILLION**_ on a MEGA ad buy to crush my re-election campaign. The neocon establishment has put a bounty on my head because I won’t support foreign wars and won’t vote to continue letting our national debt SPIRAL out of control. _I wish I could be more optimistic, but this is just the beginning of what is a declaration of_** _ALL-OUT WAR_** _on me and those who support me... _ _**_[And if I don’t pick up my fundraising efforts immediately, I'll be severely outmanned and outgunned. Because of this, what was just another end-of-quarter deadline has now become the biggest, most crucial deadline I’ve ever faced.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z5bn41apfi10d1g6sjp5fevn68trhs4su92bceg0_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpjmaoj2clh2bs)_**_ Look, my least favorite part of my job is asking generous folks like you to sacrifice your hard-earned cash. That’s why I do it so rarely.** ** _**[I wouldn’t be asking for your help right now if it weren’t absolutely vital.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z069kvtfqs8uj7nijicglpkafhjs33kqmhkgshc0_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpjmaoj2clh2bs)**_ **But this isn’t an enemy I can take lightly. This is the most powerful political apparatus in America, sitting on a massive $500 MILLION war chest.** Their smear campaign says I sided with a foreign country. Friend, the truth is, I sided with you. I didn't pledge my allegiance to my party or any of the Swamp creatures in D.C. I pledged to protect the Constitution at all costs and to keep my promises to the American people. **_They can’t stomach my presence in Washington because I'm a constant reminder of the promises they are BREAKING!_** They’re prepared to flood my race with immense sums of out-of-state cash to drag my name through the mud until they’ve BANISHED me from Washington for good. [_**So can I count on your support to help me stand strong against the full force of the neocon establishment?**_](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zgntv8herv97bbj6gnf5i0olhi7mmojvi6nk7cd8_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpjmaoj2clh2bs) **Friend, I keep my promises. You have my word that I will NEVER back down. ** Sincerely, Thomas Massie

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: Bring wholesome messaging back to children’sentertainment
body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zojjjuc7b4o1rees6nvf5qb3shosrus0t3rkptu8_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpjmaoj6cth2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zl4g0soncpsepgbgbf1jn7o4sj0crrmqisi12920_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpjmaoj6cth2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zg7929h810ub3m0dbec2fd2g81pp6r7n2ontvo6g_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpjmaoj6cth2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2za0hruptf9dpsrjp1uesnois3dkf5ih07243nhl0_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpjmaoj6cth2bs)** , you’ll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. So many children have no way of hearing God’s message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child’s life. **[So please – whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8ioaege5n6t54b05t5vlgt5qb725idjlkodav88_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpjmaoj6cth2bs)** There’s no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.
---
Sincerely,
---
| | Kirk Cameron (and Iggy!)Actor, Author, and Father

|

The #1 thing you can do today to stop the Hollywood groomers who are tearing families apart – maybe even yours – is to support the very first children’s television show in _history_ made possible by contributions from grandparents and seniors like you. **[Please send in your Founding Supporter gift and help me reclaim America with the Biblical values our country was founded upon.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z15hvl4d3qf9qer8cdkh9o93cqbekg26l1ee9if0_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpjmaoj6cth2bs)** Thank you and God bless you and your family! -- Kirk

name: Nick Searcy
subject: I saw what really happened on January 6th
body:
I was at the Capitol on January 6th.

| | |
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9ru7eprvolmoc6q29405bf94239p8d6duuoms48_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpge2oj1c5h2bs)
Friend,

I was at the Capitol on January 6th.

I didn’t see an “insurrection.” I saw Americans praying. Singing the national anthem. Waving flags. I saw families, veterans, and peaceful patriots standing up for what they believed in.

**What I didn’t expect — _what none of us could’ve imagined_ — was the brutal retaliation that followed...**

Since that day, I’ve watched in horror as men and women I stood with that day have been hunted down and treated like terrorists.

After 4 long years, the January 6th defendants have finally been pardoned. But the pardons alone aren't enough.

Some are still rotting in jail today.

Others are trying to pick up the pieces of lives that were shattered by a government determined to make an example out of them.

They've endured political persecution, lawfare, and a social stigma that sometimes makes a second chance seem impossible.

That’s why I produced the films _Capitol Punishment_ and _The War on Truth_ and why I am proud to support Stand in the Gap, a nonprofit on a mission to provide the help, hope, and healing J6ers need to succeed in their second chance.

They’re helping former January 6 defendants and their families rebuild their lives, with legal aid, health care coverage, counseling, housing support, and most importantly — hope.

[You can help Stand in the Gap give these patriots the second chance at freedom they deserve by donating today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zem6lfkl8fpidvp81p1bj4f49hcu1nnten55dh10_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpge2oj1c5h2bs)
[Donate Now](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk9g8t5p9rb4nnt7jmnd9bqntnilhiqa62uqgsso_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpge2oj1c5h2bs)
These are real people just like you and me... Fathers. Mothers. Sisters. Brothers. Patriots. Their only crime was showing up to take a stand for their beliefs.

Every one of them had their constitutional rights violated.

But the media doesn’t want you to hear their stories. The official January 6 committee suppressed the full story, cherry‐picking footage to paint the day as an “insurrection” while ignoring the peaceful majority.

The government wants them forgotten.

**But Stand in the Gap has not forgotten the prisoner.**

This remarkable organization provides real, practical help, like rent money, job training, transportation, legal referrals, trauma counseling, and health insurance, to help these persecuted patriots move on with their lives.

Stand in the Gap believes in second chances, providing support to January 6 defendants transitioning back into society after incarceration.

Let’s show these patriots they’re not forgotten, Friend.

[Will you help J6 defendants get back on their feet by donating $10, $35, $50, or even $100 to Stand in the Gap today? >>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zete918oir08b7g4mealr8nfh64fr2iqei3nvuto_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpge2oj1c5h2bs)

For many, returning to some semblance of a normal life is overwhelming.

## Cult's Houston Campus Raided
Federal authorities [raided the Houston campus](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDtuhDAQhk8DnZFfGChcpKHbtCnRgAeYyOAVnl2W20cb5Qbp_4e-7-s23IAi7csnbOj5NadhxzNHZMZjyAyM4-PKa2KMeYLtDrTsWxq01LWQrdDtEIDiNdgy-FGGTpXoVVM707Sd7MrVK2PBgeqglrPppsk1bd0qjXZWwUjjSvLvMdnqVimprK1UMBOMxhozN41zUFiJgTgdFa_I-II8xys98aimtJXRr8z3XJiPQveF7s_zrOb00m5Nj8xpf4cK3b-pCt1_bxuJJaYRojiAAgYxjyR2YEr7SQHFX00EeFIQKBiumI7y8OF-UoyUXVNYuWxA8fef_2ft6fVPAAAA__8I5IOk) of Kingdom of God Global Church yesterday as agents in North Carolina and Florida arrested its two leaders, David Taylor, 53, and Michelle Brannon, 56. Seventeen people were removed from the former hotel. The organization, which was previously known as Joshua Media Ministries International and is headquartered in Michigan, is accused of [using forced labor](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuOrDAQRVdjMpB__AIHLyHrl06IjF1AaYyN7KLp3v2oZwuT3isdHZ2vx_ywGDBu_-0Bhl5rmiPcJQAR5LmQJViud9kTQSjOHqfFLR5plly2NR9qOczeYnjPuvJm4X4UFRjRt53qh5GP1W640FarYZGtgNa50fdrKzo_Ci-61am2QvOB8UEOQnChdSO8cnZRWqm177vOMs3BI6Xc0A4EL1vW8E5PyI1LRxXMTnQWpv4xOTE53ffduD2n-HmZnNwV6MrA5JQh4IYpMjnZTOjCZ9zTVSjF-jttm6vXBets0dcYn1AIN0uYYi0FF_0oeHPuZ5WNP28MAUvXM823w2L4NaG_9Xsa-RMAAP__ABOGCw) to raise over $50 million in donations since 2014. The money was used to purchase luxury vehicles, jet skis, and lavish meals. According to an indictment, followers were forced to live in call centers or "ministry houses," where they were physically and psychologically abused. If they failed to meet fundraising goals, they were shamed, deprived of food and sleep, and threatened with divine judgment. An employee at a nearby commercial appliance store said he had [noticed red flags](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO5CAQRL8GZ4ygwRgCB5c420svtNp2e8wdmBH0rHf-_jT7CxuWSirVe38-5g-MKZ7335hp5K-9zCddLREz1bkxMi3PVzsKU2or5gfG-5nLDAp6qbwEP28Y02u23TYuagu6o1EPvTODDyp0x-hdsP3gMHhPQSH1ATXQOvjdhLDbpYvje0x58Forbe1Nb2bFxVhj9mFwDoVVtEUu9cYHMX1h29OrfFK9rSV3aTyYH02YXwImAdN1Xbd_R3m-SwETVo5rIgHTm0vAtNaY3_FvzlEe5dm4nHJfoqwYNxlPpvqNLW0vz1L5kHsluvAlYALfyzUoA70FCbtbpVWo5dKTlrA4MsZBUMp3ddweV0wpNjcIq-4ZY_p-yz9z_DnC_wAAAP__nGaOVg) at the campus. ## State Buys Historic Hotels
The Texas General Land Office purchased the historic [Crockett and Menger hotels](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OpTAMhZ8mdL4KCZefgmIbutl2S2SIgWgcghLfy7BPv2L2EaazZMvf-c6fj_EDPft9_Y2Bevla4rjTmZlEKI1ZUGh6XXmLQpxnDAf6dQ9xNNo8Qbdg2tGh52usCtdP2nVlQX3ZPGvbtJ3uiq2v7WJd67rJTlPZ0bM2uqlLcrjMk3l2WPj-fqZb05alLqvqUTo742Qra5emqWtUlSbnJaaHbCT0hXnhK74pPeYYCu43kSMr-0uZQZnhPM_HZ0a5l8oMt40yA8cZWZnhRikz6Paea2WGOcX5k0QAdweB9pUS_LeF45XmDTM5mC745sLKETB4B-HF4iF4Zh93cJEZEyBjiHAw_kVItMc3io_7jS9S747zvs51oyq9BvT8HV9-Vvq7N_8CAAD__1QWmPw) in San Antonio as part of its ongoing efforts to preserve the Alamo and enhance the visitor experience. With a MAGA majority on the court, Republicans will be free to ram through the most extreme gerrymander in the country -- dismantling safe Democratic districts, silencing competitive ones, and locking in an unbreakable GOP majority for a decade or more.

name: Andy Ngo
subject: Help me bring Antifa to justice
body:
I was one of the first savagely beaten by lawless, violent Antifa thugs

| |
---
| |
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zn259srrenf1jqnsu7sbu0h35as730as3ceqkb2o_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpie6o74c9h2bs)
---
My fellow concerned American, I was one of the first savagely beaten by lawless, violent Antifa thugs.And unless we do something to stop them today, I won’t be the last. **[I’m asking you to donate $35 or more today to help me bring Antifa and its members who assaulted me to justice.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zmibamtf1d8nkue7ec81rijqbh4du2jdhs2dgb8g_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpie6o74c9h2bs) ****I was at Antifa's "ground zero" in Portland, Oregon during the summer of 2019.** This was before most Americans had ever heard of the Antifa movement, but they'd caused havoc and violence before.I went to an Antifa "protest" as a journalist to document and report on their “protest.”As soon as I arrived, I feared for my safety.The mob was angry, and violence always follows Antifa. Most of them wore masks to prevent being identified when they commit crimes. Many had on helmets and carried riot gear. Some, I later learned, secretly had weapons like baseball bats, brass knuckles and even bricks.I was scared, but I had a job to do, so I pressed on.**People like you needed to know what was happening.** But I didn't go unnoticed for long.Somebody recognized me and bashed me on the back of my head in an ambush."F*** you, Andy Ngo!" shouted voices around me. "Go home, fascist!"**Fists started flying at my face and head. Then came the projectiles.** Before I knew it, I was being repeatedly punched, kicked, and hit with objects.I tried to protect my head. I did not strike back as I knew that would only escalate the situation and put me in more danger.The thugs robbed me of my camera so that I wouldn’t have evidence of the assault. What they did to me is unacceptable and criminal. And now they're trying to do the same to other innocent Americans like you.That's why I sued members of the Rose City Antifa organization to bring them to justice and send the loud clear message that they are NOT above the law.Now I need your help to hold their feet to the fire and make sure justice is served. [**Will you donate $35 or more to help me hold Antifa accountable?**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zvo8tjau6s9nccoqnjg0ave79jh8umnn38799bbg_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpie6o74c9h2bs) This is bigger than me alone. After I got away from the mob, police finally showed up when I was in the hospital. But my attackers stole my evidence and nearly silenced me permanently with a traumatic brain injury.Later, cell phone footage from a bystander surfaced online. Thank goodness! The video captured part of the attack, clear as day.I hoped I'd get the justice I deserved.Wrong.To this day, six years later, the Portland Police have done nothing.**No charges. No arrests. No suspects questioned.** It's not much of a surprise, though.Radical politicians have long since bowed to the dangerous left-wing mobs that terrorize their streets. That’s why the Center for American Liberty helped me file a lawsuit against my attackers. A judge ordered three of them to pay damages – but more than a year later and they have not paid a dime.So now the Center for American Liberty is helping me track them down and make them pay for nearly killing me and trampling upon the First Amendment.Unfortunately it’s going to cost at least $20,000 to get justice.[**That's why I hope you'll join the fight by donating $35 or more to fund my efforts to hold Antifa and its members accountable.**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z64ujsniin3n5jq5li9o387pap6vovee555tf9b0_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpie6o74c9h2bs) We have to stop Antifa and make them face real, legal consequences for their destructive actions before they get to you and your family.Antifa wants the literal end of America -- and they'll stop at nothing to get it. Believe me when I say that's not an overstatement. Some members are avowed socialists or communists. But many are much worse – open violent anarchists who want to tear down civilization and remake it in their own twisted vision with no law and order.By any means necessary.**_Rioting. Destruction. Mayhem._** And they know, as long as they choose politically favored protests to co-opt, the media and politicians will never have the guts to denounce their violence or hold them accountable. They did that with BLM. They’re doing it now against ICE.It's a sick strategy, but very smart – because so far, they've been successful.**For the most part, they've gotten off scot-free.** Our politicians and media are treating this terrorist group like peaceful protestors!As we saw in Los Angeles earlier this summer, their riots will only spread and intensify if Antifa continue to escape consequences.**So now I'm taking justice into my own hands – with the help of the talented lawyers at the Center for American Liberty.**

[**You can be a part of bringing Antifa to justice with a donation of $35 or more today.**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zo1l76hsm85la06cihh7sn5vvle5kl1rm8p2ffh0_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpie6o74c9h2bs) Though I'm seeking justice for myself, the impact of this case could be so much larger.This is about standing up for our country when our own leaders won't.This is about saving America as we know it and keeping you and your family safe.And this is just the first blow we intend to deliver.By taking them to court for the attack against me we can prove they are NOT untouchable. **[Can I count on you to donate $35 or more to help me get justice from Antifa?](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zma70cd6val4bieaoialu51gd01qdbca8b3ash70_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpie6o74c9h2bs) **Please don't wait – if we don't fight back and win now, **these violent thugs will be in EVERY city across America** , destroying everything and everyone in their path. Thank you in advance for your support.

---
| Letter from the Chair
---
What does the Nebraska Republican Party (NEGOP) do?
That's a question I hear often, especially when fundraising. Many people, myself included, like to give directly to candidates. But the Party plays an important role that individual candidates cannot fill on their own, and it needs support to carry out those responsibilities.
Last week, I attended my second Republican National Committee (RNC) meeting in Atlanta, where the 168 members elected a new Chairman, Joe Gruters, who was endorsed by President Trump. The "168" refers to the Chairman, Committeewoman, and Committeeman from each state, along with representatives from the District of Columbia and five U.S. territories. Former Chairman Michael Whatley will now be running for U.S. Senate in North Carolina.
One of the biggest benefits of attending an RNC meeting is seeing how important strong Republican organizations are at every level. The President himself is deeply engaged with the national Party and is, without question, our leader. Vice President JD Vance also spoke at the meeting, along with representatives of the President. These gatherings make it clear just how vital state parties are to the success of the national effort.
Here in Nebraska, the NEGOP is a key piece of that structure. When the State Party is organized and effective, it strengthens districts and counties, creating a unified political strategy. This structure is the foundation for maintaining the Party's brand and achieving electoral success.
What sets each state party apart? While the RNC develops a national platform, every state party creates its own. The national platform is presented and voted on every four years at the GOP Presidential Convention. Nebraska's platform will be reviewed, updated, and voted on in 2026. Both the national and state platforms outline Republican principles, policies, and priorities. They are meant to guide our candidates, and while they are aligned, each reflects the unique needs and priorities of its state.
Financially, the NEGOP is also able to support candidates in ways they cannot do on their own. This includes certain transfers and expenditures, especially for federal candidates, as well as funding shared initiatives like voter registration drives and get-out-the-vote efforts. Much of this work is funded through "party building" contributions rather than donations made to specific campaigns.
At the end of the day, the NEGOP is part of a much larger effort. We play our role in electing Republicans at every level, from federal races to local precincts. We are preparing, building, and working to strengthen our Party. When we work together, we win.
Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party
---
---
| |
---
---
| |
# What's Happening...
---
From the legislative desk
On August 14th, the NEGOP convened a community roundtable in Scottsbluff focused on healthcare access and affordability. It brought together residents, healthcare providers, local leaders, and policymakers to address pressing challenges in our healthcare system, including Medicaid reforms included in the Big Beautiful Bill, and identify solutions to ensure access to affordable care. Panelists included Congressman Adrian Smith, State Senator Brian Hardin, Jessica Davies, Panhandle Public Health Director, Kent Ewing, Mayor of Gering, and Cory Morris, Heritage Estates Administrator. I was privileged to serve as moderator for the event.
Rising costs of prescriptions, insurance premiums, and out-of-pocket expenses were central concerns. Community members shared personal stories of financial strain and difficult choices between medical care and basic needs. Local panel members provided shared perspectives on operational challenges they each face and underscored the urgency of reform. Congressman Smith and Senator Hardin provided valuable insights into ongoing obstacles and legislative efforts to improve healthcare affordability, including additional reforms.
Several community members expressed their appreciation for the Congressman and Senator's commitment to listening and engaging with their concerns. Special thanks to Chairman Mary Jane Truemper, Kay Schroder, and Margaret Applegarth for their help with the event. Future roundtables are listed below, and you are encouraged to attend. Details will be included in the Chairman's newsletter as they get closer. Last week I attended my first RNC meeting in Atlanta. The meeting focused on party leadership transitions and strategic planning for the 2026 midterm elections. It was thrilling for me to be in the room to witness former RNC chair, Michael Whatley, pass the gavel to our new RNC Chair, Joe Gruters, after a unanimous election. There was a strong sense of party unity and excitement in the room.

subject: Why We Should Study War
body:
Tech is moving fast. Don’t get left behind. Get your early copy of the Stanford Emerging Tech Review now.

# The Stanford Emerging Tech Review 2025
| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z0kcs5cdpsdf0s9c848l8chaons0c80avp92hq08_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpieepr4c5h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

Wars begin. Freedoms fade. Hard-won peace unravels.

The question is why.

One answer: we've stopped studying military history. And when that knowledge fades, so does our ability to understand today's conflicts--or anticipate tomorrow's.
---
|
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zv5flududie43otfkjtcbb5317hlj999a59q8988_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpieepr4c5h2bs)
---
| | Victor Davis Hanson believes this is no small matter.

In a new ebook from the Hoover Institution, _Why We Should Study War_ , Hanson examines what military history reveals about human nature, conflict, and the cost of preserving peace. His analysis draws on historical case studies and connects them to the challenges facing the world today.

Without knowledge of military history, we risk:
* Repeating past mistakes
* Making uninformed decisions about current and future conflicts
* Undervaluing the sacrifices made for our freedoms

I'd like to share this ebook with you--which includes Hanson's core arguments for studying war along with his answers to key questions about deterrence, WWII, and essential military history reading.

Inside, you'll discover:
* How studying war is, in essence, an attempt to prevent it
* Why human nature and the patterns of conflict remain constant across time
* What battles from Shiloh to Verdun to Okinawa teach us about sacrifice
* How military history provides moral education about the cost of freedom
Why the United States--"born through war, reunited by war, and saved from destruction by war"--must never forget this knowledge
* Understanding the past is essential so we can engage more seriously with the present.

I hope this material deepens your appreciation for military history--and informs how you think about peace, conflict, and public responsibility.

You can request your free copy using the link below:
[https://resources.hoover.org/why-we-should-study-war](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z6sdd7g72t6qvlnt0urcomepgi5c8utmd5u16v60_rp22sh2s8i6epb3cpieepr4c5h2bs) Greg

Greg Stamps | Online Development
Hoover Institution | Stanford University
With its eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and Archives, the Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven policy research organization that seeks to improve the human condition by advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity, national security, and democratic governance. Over more than one hundred years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that have produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the United States and around the world.

It has been over a week since President Donald Trump sent additional federal agents and D.C. National Guardsmen into the nation's capital in an effort to bring down the city's crime rate, and it has been a resounding success so far.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..i65tgZYRzEeLSmq1rpwWqdFbVNDf7zoHUoH45Il4HDM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=172167932)
During the first full week of the additional resources and manpower in the D.C., there was not a single murder within the city limits for the first time in months and the first time in a long time during the summer months.
As I wrote last week, the effects of Trump sending in the federal government to address crime will show how the tolerance for crime, big and small, is by choice, and it is a choice Democrats are happy to make when it comes to tolerating it because the real solution is unacceptable to them.
The drop in crime is more than just the murders. The union for the Metropolitan Police Department **[reported other major crimes had seen a significant decrease.](https://substack.com/redirect/c51e5b21-e20d-401c-b2e6-e1bc55e545f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Robberies dropped 46%, assault with a deadly weapon dropped 6%, carjackings dropped 83%, car theft dropped 21%, and crime overall has dropped 8% after Trump's takeover.
It is worth remembering how the crime statistics prior to the federal takeover appeared to be cooked to make it look like crime was lower than it actually was. This is why the Democratic talking point of crime decreasing can not be taken seriously because not only do the numbers appear to be fudged, but those numbers are still higher than they were prior to 2020. The "Defund the Police" movement and the nonsense response to COVID-19 has led to negative effects that has lasted for years.

## **Are Your Retirement Savings Ready?**
President Trump's "One Big Beautiful Bill" strives to deliver the largest tax cuts for working and middle class Americans in our country's history. His bold plan not only extends the historic 2017 tax cuts but introduces even deeper reforms aimed at empowering American workers and retirees.
But here's the catch:
This new economic agenda may come with both massive opportunity and serious risk for anyone with a traditional retirement account--like a 401(k), IRA, or TSP.
The fatal flaw? These accounts are built on a Wall Street system that assumes stability, free from manipulation and political shocks.
And in today's world, all it could take is one major event--another bank failure, a geopolitical crisis, a market crash--to wipe out decades of your savings like it did in the 2008 Financial Crisis.
**[We've outlined a wealth protection strategy](https://substack.com/redirect/5436f461-9067-4f06-bf8e-27fe17dc3371?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** inside the 2025 Retirement Protection Guide -- and it's completely FREE. Inside this guide, you'll discover an IRS-approved loophole that allows you to move your retirement savings tax-free and penalty-free into a safe haven asset and hedge your wealth against inflation, market volatility and geopolitical crises.
Time is short. Trump's reforms may be coming fast--and the financial system roller coaster may be a ride that you don't want to take with your retirement savings.
**> > [Get Your FREE Copy of the 2025 Retirement Protection Guide](https://substack.com/redirect/5436f461-9067-4f06-bf8e-27fe17dc3371?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) <<**
[Get My Free Guide](https://substack.com/redirect/5436f461-9067-4f06-bf8e-27fe17dc3371?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
_**(Piece continues)**_
It is a pattern seen across the United States in Democrat-controlled cities. Even though it looks as though the high crime rate is dropping, there are many crimes that are still being committed at a rate that should be intolerable.
While Trump has made the right steps to get crime under our nation's capital under control, the pro-criminal policies passed by the city council are still in effect and that same mindset is still embedded in the city's judiciary.
This is evident in the assault case of Big Balls, whose beating spurred Trump into action. Two teenagers who were charged for the attempted carjacking, with Big Balls fending off his attackers as best as he could, have already been released from juvenile custody. A judge ordered the release of one of the teens to a youth shelter and the other to home confinement, **[according to NBC Washington.](https://substack.com/redirect/10f0a61e-e1c0-41da-8e23-266d2288747c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Young offenders in D.C. are consistently given slaps on the wrist for serious crimes, which does nothing to stop them from going back out to commit similar crimes again.

Eventually, the extra manpower Trump sent into the city will go home or to other assignments, leaving the Metropolitan Police Department to deal with what they have been dealing with for years. The department is supposed to have 4,000 officers but they barely have over 3,000. Officers on the force recorded 1.8 million overtime hours because of the manpower shortage. The progressive population is even more radicalized against MPD because they dared took the help offered to them by Trump.
While I think putting D.C. under total federal control could lead to a few problems down the line in future, Democratic presidential administrations, it has long been clear a local city council is unable to govern _our_ nation's capital. As I said before, D.C. should be one of the best cities to live and work in. It represents the United States to the rest of the country and to the world.
It is shameful that Mexico City, which is home to a population of 22 million, is safer than the United States' capital, whose population is fewer than one million. Trump's plan has had major successes. He just needs to solidify it in D.C. and across the country.

But I cannot win with this crippling cash disadvantage. TO MAKE MATTERS WORSE, I'm facing a CRUCIAL Deadline Goal and I'm WAY behind! in a serious bind here, Peter. I'm over $10,000 behind pace to reach my upcoming Goal. I'm asking you as a Christian, a Marine, and a mother: Democrat opponent has Leftist billionaires like George Soros and Hollywood liberals backing her, but I'm 100% relying on you! can't thank you enough for reading this message all the way through, Peter. | | Dear Patriot, **Did Barack Obama commit treason when he launched a multi-front campaign to destroy Donald Trump, his allies, and cripple his incoming Administration?** My answer is “Yes” because I was personally and professionally destroyed by them. Barack Obama along with Hillary Clinton, Susan Rice, James Comey, and other power-hungry radicals concocted this scheme from inside the White House. But the real conspiracy wasn’t just behind closed doors. Everyone was in on it – especially and most dangerously the mainstream media. I’m talking about 24/7 hit pieces. The never-ending barrage of mysterious leaks. Their conspiracy was made possible by collaborators inside the FBI like James Comey and the House Intelligence Committee like Adam Schiff who lied to your face that they had evidence to “get” Trump. This is why I’ve partnered with my friends at the American Media Council to make sure we can reshape the media landscape before the next hoax can destroy our country. **[Today, I’m asking you to join me in supporting their critical mission.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** It’s a mission I care deeply about because I was the target of the Fake News’ lies. Here’s the truth: Obama and Hillary didn’t have a lick of evidence when they cooked up this hoax. Here’s the _disturbing_ truth: they didn’t need any. They could make up whatever they wanted to and feed it to the mainstream media monster. That’s exactly what they did. Let me explain:
---
1. They planted fake evidence in the mainstream media.

2. The mainstream media ran them as if they were fact.

3. The mainstream media's coverage was cited as proof the fake evidence was real.

---
It was terrible circular logic built on a mountain of lies. **But it worked.** It worked because the liberal media drilled it into the minds of millions of Americans that President Trump was some kind of traitor. The whole time, these Trump-hating journalists celebrated their role in making this hoax a reality. The Washington Post even won a Pulitzer Prize over it! The level to which the liberal media went to justify this insanity was insane itself. That’s why today I’m honored to partner with a group who’s fighting to stop another hoax like this from destroying our country. The American Media Council understands what’s really going on: **The power-hungry radicals in Washington who have weaponized our government have also weaponized the mainstream media.** Their mission is to restore truth in the media before the Fake News can destroy our country. They’re the reason I’m able to write you this. What I deeply respect about the American Media Council is that they aren’t sitting back and watching it happen. They’re on the frontlines trying to make a difference.
---
* They publish the facts behind top media hoaxes.
* They hold journalists accountable with their “Truth in Journalism” Pledge.
* They give out “Trustworthy Ratings” to help patriots like you know which sites you can trust.

---
But that’s not all. Thanks to the generous support of patriots like you, they have a **“First Amendment Fund”** to help conservatives overcome lawfare waged by the mainstream media. **[Today, will you consider filling their “First Amendment Fund” with a donation of $35 or more?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** A $35 donation would be a tremendous help. But if you feel called to make a monthly donation, say $15 or more, I will send you a complimentary copy of Pardon of Innocence. It’s so important to me that you support the American Media Council that I want to “Thank You” with a complimentary book. My friend, it’s hard to put into words just how impactful your support will be today... ... but I’ll try. The Deep State wanted to destroy me. They tried to take away my career and financially bankrupt my family. I had to sell my house to pay the endless legal fees. It put my wife, Lori, through hell and back. That’s the Left’s goal. **Humiliation. Retaliation. Destruction.** Sadly, the damage to my reputation can’t be fixed in a courtroom or wiped from the internet. President Donald Trump pardoned me. My name has been officially cleared. But no matter where I go... certain people will always see me the way the liberal media painted me. That’s why the Left pushes these hoaxes. It’s all about inflicting **maximum punishment** on anybody who dares to stand up against their radical doctrine. Your support of the American Media Council and their **“First Amendment Fund”** today will directly help patriots like me clear their names and stand up against the liberal media’s lies. This is only possible with your support today. **[Will you support the American Media Council just like I do?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** If you’re in a position to sign up for a monthly donation today – $15 or more – I will send you a complimentary copy of Pardon of Innocence as my sincere thanks.
---
Thank You and God Bless You
---
Lt. Gen. Michael Flynn
---
[ **DONATE** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---

P.S. As my deepest thanks for supporting the American Media Council and their critical mission, I want to send you a complimentary copy of my new book, Pardon of Innocence. **[All it takes is your monthly gift of $15 or more.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** But in truth, any gift amount you can send today – whether $35 or some other amount – it will be a tremendous help. No matter the amount you can send today, I want you to know that I’m grateful there are still patriots like you out there who believe in the truth. As long as you’re still around, the Fake News liars will never win.

Oklahoma has the highest rates of domestic violence and the worst maternal death rates nationwide. They have one of the strictest abortion bans in the country, with no exceptions for rape or incest. As Governor, Cyndi will repeal the abortion ban in her state. As she has been traveling across the state meeting with voters, she’s found that voters on both sides of the aisle feel that the current anti-abortion laws do not meet their values and instead prevent women from getting the care they need.

**Additionally, birth control is at risk (!!!).** While debating a bill to make it easier for women to obtain contraceptives, an OK Republican State Senator, Dusty Deevers, stated that birth control “induces the abortion or murder of a human embryo” and argued that **women’s brains shrink while on birth control.** This is one of the men making laws about women’s bodies in Oklahoma. 🤯

**Women need a champion in Oklahoma.** According to the 2024 March of Dimes report, 51.9% of Oklahomans do not have access to maternity healthcare, and an additional 18.2% have low/moderate access to healthcare.

**As Governor, Cyndi wants to increase access to maternity healthcare for women across the state, and fully eliminate these healthcare deserts through legislation that would support increased funding for hospitals and assist in the recruitment of doctors who specialize in women’s healthcare.**

Here’s the thing: We’ve seen Democratic Governors win in “red” states – despite having Republican supermajorities in their State Houses and Senate chambers. Kentucky and Kansas, for example, both elected popular Democratic Governors. Cyndi has been building the momentum needed in her state to get the job done. If anyone can do it, it’s her.

[**Cyndi will serve as a deeply needed champion for the women of her state. **You and I know art wasn 't always this way. **

Hello Derek, Our next FEC deadline is rapidly approaching. With statewide elections in Virginia and New Jersey coming up, and the Trump administration doubling down on executive overreach, having a strong, united Democratic Party is more important than ever. But only if we get to work _now_.** We’re going after vulnerable House Republicans in 35 key districts. We’re coming for Senate seats in states like North Carolina and Ohio. body:
Rising prices on groceries, rent, and everyday necessities are being made worse by Republicans’ extremist agenda and Trump’s tariffs. It’s clear they don’t have Nevada’s working families in mind. Republicans are only looking out for themselves and their ultrawealthy donors. | | | |

Hey friend,
Nevada’s working families are being squeezed from every direction.
Rising prices on groceries, rent, and everyday necessities are being made worse by Republicans’ extremist agenda and Trump’s tariffs. It’s clear they don’t have Nevada’s working families in mind. **Republicans are only looking out for themselves and their ultrawealthy donors.**
I am standing up to these harmful and reckless economic policies — fighting for the Nevada we know and love – but I can’t do it without you.
Republicans are coming after me once again, adding me and the rest of NV’s Democratic House members to their top target list for 2026 in their quest to hold power. But they aren’t battle born and tested. With your help, we will win.

I sat down this week planning to write about why I became a gun owner.
It was going to be uncomfortable but honest: about a death threat I received that named my son, about months of training and long conversations with my wife, about finally buying a firearm even though I've spent my career fighting for stronger gun control and most of my adult life never thinking I'd have any reason to own one.
I wanted to write about the tension of being both an outspoken Democratic strategist and a gun owner. About how I wanted to be transparent with my readers, and how leaning into discomfort is sometimes the only way I know how to grow.
And then, before I even hit "publish," the news broke. A Catholic school in Minnesota. Three dead. Seventeen injured. Kids as young as eight and ten. Parents still waiting for word if their children made it out alive.
I went live with Don Lemon as the news came in, and I'll be honest: I fucking lost it. I couldn't stop thinking about my six-year-old son, who just last year came home from school after his first "active shooter drill." One of the worst days of my life as a parent was trying to explain to him why he had to practice hiding from someone with a gun. How do you answer that question when the truth is: we don't keep kids safe in this country? That active shooter drills don't guarantee anything.
And here's the kicker--my six-year-old son asked me better questions than most of the people in power. We tell children to hide in closets instead of keeping guns out of dangerous hands. We traumatize them instead of protecting them. And when the inevitable happens--as it did yesterday in Minnesota--we call it a tragedy, but not a crisis.
It _is_ a crisis. It's evil. And the part that wrecks me is: it's avoidable.
We know what to do. It's as simple as first-grade math. Keep guns out of dangerous hands. Pass laws that already have overwhelming support--even from responsible gun owners like myself. Invest in community policing and school safety. Treat mental health as part of the solution, not a throwaway talking point. Stop pretending this is normal. Stop pretending this is "American."
And while families grieve, Fox News and the rest of the right-wing media ecosystem are out here doing what they always do: pointing fingers at anyone but the people actually responsible. Their new favorite scapegoat? Trans people.
They are so desperate for an enemy that they're inventing one--screaming that the trans community is "grooming" kids into violent criminals. Out of more than 5,000 mass shootings in the last decade, _four_ involved someone who was trans. Four. That's their evidence. It's pathetic. It's grotesque.
And it proves what we already know: the conservative movement doesn't give a damn about keeping kids alive. They don't care about solutions to any problem. They don't care about safety. They care about feeding their bloodlust, stoking fear, and attacking already vulnerable kids. They're not going to lift a finger to make sure my son--or your kid--is safe in their classroom. They're just going to keep scapegoating trans children (and ignoring the obvious signs that this person was radicalized by far-right media) like the soulless, creepy weirdos they are.
And here's one final thing that infuriates me: the empty "thoughts and prayers" debate. I'm a practicing Catholic. Prayer is part of my life. I believe it matters. But as has been said many times, faith without works is nothing. And there are a lot of people out there who claim to be Christian, who claim to pray, who claim to care--but when push comes to shove, when it's time to protect kids, to care for their community, to do the right thing, they don't. If the only thing you have in a crisis is "thoughts and prayers" without any action, then you are not living up to your Christian values. Period.
This isn't about me. It's about parents yesterday who didn't know if they'll ever see their kids again. Families who will carry this grief for the rest of their lives while this country continues to shrug.
And unless we make this a voting issue--unless we defeat these Republicans and replace them with a Democratic Party that has the stomach to do what it takes to solve this crisis--kids will keep dying.

clean_body: Another school shooting leaves families shattered while the GOP offers scapegoats instead of solutions. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? Another school shooting leaves families shattered while the GOP offers scapegoats instead of solutions. | | | Aug 28 | | | | | | | | | | | | I sat down this week planning to write about why I became a gun owner. It was going to be uncomfortable but honest: about a death threat I received that named my son, about months of training and long conversations with my wife, about finally buying a firearm even though I've spent my career fighting for stronger gun control and most of my adult life never thinking I'd have any reason to own one. I wanted to write about the tension of being both an outspoken Democratic strategist and a gun owner. About how I wanted to be transparent with my readers, and how leaning into discomfort is sometimes the only way I know how to grow. And then, before I even hit "publish," the news broke. A Catholic school in Minnesota. Three dead. Seventeen injured. Kids as young as eight and ten. Parents still waiting for word if their children made it out alive. I went live with Don Lemon as the news came in, and I'll be honest: I fucking lost it. I couldn't stop thinking about my six-year-old son, who just last year came home from school after his first "active shooter drill." One of the worst days of my life as a parent was trying to explain to him why he had to practice hiding from someone with a gun. How do you answer that question when the truth is: we don't keep kids safe in this country? That active shooter drills don't guarantee anything. And here's the kicker--my six-year-old son asked me better questions than most of the people in power. We tell children to hide in closets instead of keeping guns out of dangerous hands. We traumatize them instead of protecting them. And when the inevitable happens--as it did yesterday in Minnesota--we call it a tragedy, but not a crisis. It is a crisis. It's evil. And the part that wrecks me is: it's avoidable. We know what to do. It's as simple as first-grade math. Keep guns out of dangerous hands. Pass laws that already have overwhelming support--even from responsible gun owners like myself. Invest in community policing and school safety. Treat mental health as part of the solution, not a throwaway talking point. Stop pretending this is normal. Stop pretending this is "American." And while families grieve, Fox News and the rest of the right-wing media ecosystem are out here doing what they always do: pointing fingers at anyone but the people actually responsible. Their new favorite scapegoat? Trans people. They are so desperate for an enemy that they're inventing one--screaming that the trans community is "grooming" kids into violent criminals. Out of more than 5,000 mass shootings in the last decade, four involved someone who was trans. Four. That's their evidence. It's pathetic. It's grotesque. And it proves what we already know: the conservative movement doesn't give a damn about keeping kids alive. They don't care about solutions to any problem. They don't care about safety. They care about feeding their bloodlust, stoking fear, and attacking already vulnerable kids. They're not going to lift a finger to make sure my son--or your kid--is safe in their classroom. They're just going to keep scapegoating trans children (and ignoring the obvious signs that this person was radicalized by far-right media) like the soulless, creepy weirdos they are. And here's one final thing that infuriates me: the empty "thoughts and prayers" debate. I'm a practicing Catholic. Prayer is part of my life. I believe it matters. But as has been said many times, faith without works is nothing. And there are a lot of people out there who claim to be Christian, who claim to pray, who claim to care--but when push comes to shove, when it's time to protect kids, to care for their community, to do the right thing, they don't. If the only thing you have in a crisis is "thoughts and prayers" without any action, then you are not living up to your Christian values. Period. This isn't about me. It's about parents yesterday who didn't know if they'll ever see their kids again. Families who will carry this grief for the rest of their lives while this country continues to shrug. And unless we make this a voting issue--unless we defeat these Republicans and replace them with a Democratic Party that has the stomach to do what it takes to solve this crisis--kids will keep dying. | Dear Fellow American,

On behalf of all of us at Judicial Watch, I want to wish you and those close to you an enjoyable and relaxing Labor Day holiday weekend. I hope you have had a great summer!
I also want to thank you for for your interest in our work as America's largest open records laws litigator and government watchdog.
And I want you to know that the Judicial Watch team has been hard at work this summer fighting (and winning) for clean elections and maximum transparency in government.
_Some recent Judicial Watch victories include:_

* Our historic honest elections work, as we advance through the courts with our "clean voter rolls" lawsuits against **California, Illinois** and **Oregon (** Judicial Watch lawsuits have been responsible for removing over 5 million ineligible names from voter rolls to date and we're just getting started);

* Legal challenges to reckless **California, Illinois** and **Mississippi** laws that "extend" **Election Day** and undermine faith in our elections;
* Providing critical support to **President Trump** and **DOGE** by exposing and educating the public about government waste, fraud, abuse and corruption (battles that, I'm proud to say, Judicial Watch has been waging successfully for 31 years!);
* And taking on federal, state and local government agencies that continue to advance "**diversity, equity and inclusion** " (**DEI**), reparations and other woke racist programs.

We will be hitting the ground running next week, as we prepare for a very busy fall... especially oral arguments before the **U.S. Supreme Court** on October 8, in our "extending Election Day" lawsuit against **Illinois**!
None of our work would be possible without the generous contributions that our members and community of patriotic supporters, have made to Judicial Watch. Their support is truly the lifeblood of all we do and are daily doses of inspiration for our entire team.
Thank you, again, for your interest in our mission to uphold the rule of law and the American people's "right to know."
And enjoy the holiday weekend!

Peter, I have a truly hilarious and therapeutic read for you. Last Friday, Politico published an [article](https://xtz223.keap-link015.com/v2/click/67481c25314616b7e603f0deb5e3e1f2/eJyNkMtOwzAQRf_F66R-JBElu6qqqiilCwRrZJxRa8WxLXtC-lD-HRdQVyCxnTlzru5cCYKVFpuO1OSEFyEKkpEASnsNFtfOolRfW1GVvOAZMdr22-BGT-rrr8d34DZe8lJkBM8eEvLyvFq3zX77tmv2bSK9DCnjX54HVrC7Z_O0anZknv8Uw6Bx85HckdQYRrg16nRqha_BJP6I6GNN6TRNC--MRq3cQrmBWpgiFUxUlC2pELSDwakgMeaT6yE30h5GeYD83UjVGx0xZ6zij6XgKVV6D7b7eVkL5-_s-RP5_nNx) aptly titled, “**The ‘woke’ words Democrats should cut from their vocabulary** ” with an equally apt subtitle: “ _A new memo identifies 45 words and phrases for Democrats to avoid, alleging the terms turn voters off. They span six categories — from “therapy speak” to “explaining away crime.”_ You can read the full piece [here](https://xtz223.keap-link015.com/v2/click/c78ae51625d496397e99e3e255cefef8/eJyNkMtOwzAQRf_F66R-JBElu6qqqiilCwRrZJxRa8WxLXtC-lD-HRdQVyCxnTlzru5cCYKVFpuO1OSEFyEKkpEASnsNFtfOolRfW1GVvOAZMdr22-BGT-rrr8d34DZe8rLMCJ49JOTlebVum_32bdfs20R6GVLGvzwPrGB3z-Zp1ezIPP8phkHj5iO5I6kxjHBr1OnUCl-DSfwR0cea0mmaFt4ZjVq5hXIDtTBFKpioKFtSIWgHg1NBYswn10NupD2M8gD5u5GqNzpizljFH0vBU6r0Hmz387IWzt_Z8yf7_nNz) for a good laugh, but I’ll drop a few of my favorite lines below.
---

I think we can all agree these are aggravating, meaningless, and stupid phrases that no Common Sense New Jerseyan would ever use. And they have certainly driven the divide between the Left and the rest of us (or “normies” as the article hilariously refers to them). It’s just another signal of how divorced from reality and common sense ideas the Left has become. _BUT._ There is a big _but_ here. The Left has always had an obsession with marketing (or, dare I say, propaganda, spin, and manipulation) precisely because their ideas are so bad that they must trick, shame or otherwise strong-arm the public into supporting them. So what we see in this article isn’t a realization that they’ve been peddling dangerous and harmful ideas that have destroyed our state and countless futures. They aren’t having an awakening. They are reeling from political _losses_ and realizing the _marketing_ isn’t working. They want to put a new face on the same bad ideas. And we aren’t going to let that slide. Because while the words are darn annoying, they aren’t the real problem. Treating taxpayers like their blank check is the real problem.
Ignoring (and even celebrating) crime is the real problem.
Acting as if they own our children is the real problem.
Using us to enrich themselves is the real problem.
Flaunting the law and abusing law enforcement is the real problem.
Spending like there’s no tomorrow is the real problem. The most “authentic” and “normal person” packaging can hide the impact of those ideas. But hey, while we’re having fun, which words would you LOVE to ban from the Lefty-lexicon? [**Shoot me an email!**](mailto:e@commonsenseclub.org) For New Jersey,

Hey friends,
Something extremely exciting is happening in Maine that I wanted to flag for you. As I wrote in _[The Nation](https://substack.com/redirect/a4aa8439-69f3-4bfd-9786-eaf22910bf77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , and describe below, this guy is the real deal.
* * *
"I did four infantry tours in the Marine Corps and the Army. I'm not afraid to name an enemy. And the enemy is the oligarchy. It's the billionaires who pay for it, and the politicians who sell us out."
Graham Platner delivers these lines in the [video](https://substack.com/redirect/88359887-5990-4ac7-b192-69d4e9673e1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) announcing his out-of-nowhere campaign against Maine's Republican senator, Susan Collins. In the viral clip, Platner is leaning casually against the wheel of a small boat. He's wearing a stained sweatshirt, but without any of the Fetterman affect--this is a working oysterman in his normal attire. He's got a gravelly voice, a bristly beard, and ruggedly casual charisma. But beyond the working-class aesthetic, it's this line in particular--"I'm not afraid to name an enemy"--that I think explains his magnetic draw. Americans [understand](https://substack.com/redirect/eeb2cf96-e8c3-4543-905e-3dc7f65f7b70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the system is rigged, and we're hungry for candidates with the guts and honesty to call out the villains causing our pain.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/88359887-5990-4ac7-b192-69d4e9673e1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In his launch video--which has already racked up more than 4 million views on X--as well as every other statement he's made over the last week, there is no trace of the anodyne consultant-speak that has become so synonymous with Democratic politicians. Platner does not blandly talk about an "opportunity economy"--he growls that "the fabric of what holds us together is being ripped apart by billionaires and corrupt politicians." He doesn't try to rise above the fray--he says outright that watching his state "become essentially unlivable for working people" makes him "deeply angry."
In his campaign for Senate, Platner embodies the populist energy that so many Americans--Democrats, independents, and Republicans--have been looking for in their leaders, and that the Democratic Party establishment has failed to embrace, despite the urgent need to do so.
Democrats ignored alarm bells in November, when Kamala Harris [rejected](https://substack.com/redirect/112c2e5b-dc1c-4778-98ba-287c23011385?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a populist strategy and proceeded to [lose ground](https://substack.com/redirect/5c63dc11-d2e3-4db1-8626-1f1d1a68cbdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across the [working class](https://substack.com/redirect/3846f948-7b17-4be7-a499-afd1fc35b8c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). With Democratic leaders clinging to the center, the party is [hemorrhaging voters](https://substack.com/redirect/26fc8052-d3e2-453d-b372-f19e5881f8c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across the country, particularly among men and young people. The [Democratic Party](https://substack.com/redirect/de0ac785-65f6-4a6f-b3d2-291696922c36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has a -32 approval rating. Meanwhile the populist Bernie Sanders remains [the most popular politician in the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/a9cf48d0-8b68-4021-90e1-1df93e2a33cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). If you look at the Democrats who voted in 2020 but sat out the 2024 election, it's clear what they're looking for. As pollster Celinda Lake [recently found](https://substack.com/redirect/163fa0a0-a040-4074-bdda-f79de21aec97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), these voters "want leaders who will fight for everyone.... They're very populist."
Platner doesn't need consultants or pollsters to tell him what working-class Mainers want, because as he said on August 22, "[They're my neighbors](https://substack.com/redirect/ba64dcd9-cc35-4d7a-90a0-dadca8aec907?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." In another recent [interview,](https://substack.com/redirect/2f512848-f5d9-45a9-bd9d-88ec69f64113?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) he told ABC News, "I drink coffee every morning with the guys that I work next to, who are friends of mine, who all voted for Donald Trump. And they voted for Donald Trump because they wanted something new, they wanted change." He believes that the path to winning back these voters is not cautious triangulation; it's proving to them that the Democratic Party is "the party of fighting for big structural change to benefit working class people."
This approach would be a different challenge for Collins than the Democratic campaigns she has bested in the past. In 2020, the DC establishment coronated former House speaker Sara Gideon as Maine's Democratic nominee for the US Senate. Gideon--a transplant who hailed from southern Maine, the wealthier part of the state--did not associate herself with any memorable policy commitments or plans. She [ran](https://substack.com/redirect/55ef3cc6-9b21-405c-b856-c88dd7512375?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as a moderate who could get things (unclear what things) done by working across the aisle. She raised a jaw-dropping $69 million. And she lost by nearly nine points.
Democrats need to try something new. Yet the DC establishment is [recruiting](https://substack.com/redirect/e5406ad2-2e13-4d79-9d45-e5a333581282?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a candidate, Governor Janet Mills, who will bring many of the same liabilities as Gideon. There's some logic to this push--Mills is a two-term governor, and that comes with advantages. But Mills is the [second-least-popular](https://substack.com/redirect/a5446606-0ea0-4522-9e26-5aac96dc342b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) governor in the country, and the [majority of Mainers](https://substack.com/redirect/9ad08083-9181-4650-9c0b-ec45e8777271?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) don't want her to run for Senate. She's also in her late 70s--in fact, she would be the oldest freshman senator in history, at a moment when the Democratic Party has a gerontocracy problem. It also doesn't bode well that Mills has been lukewarm in her interest in a Senate run.
A frequent [complaint](https://substack.com/redirect/8d8dfbcf-5e08-40a7-86c0-edf40a4cb412?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about Gideon's campaign was that it focused almost exclusively on advertising and failed to prioritize retail campaigning. Showing up matters in a small state like Maine, and Democrats need a candidate who's enthusiastic about traveling across the state, campaigning in every county and town, and putting in the work to win, not one who needs to be convinced to do so.
Perhaps more importantly, Platner's progressive populist values allow him to draw contrasts with Collins that an establishment Democrat like Mills likely wouldn't. Israel's genocide in Gaza offers a perfect example. Platner's position is clear: He told _[Jewish Insider](https://substack.com/redirect/d544c75c-0471-44c1-ba21-53321f71d436?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , "What is happening in Gaza is a genocide. I refuse to take money from AIPAC or any group that supports the genocide in Gaza."
This is approaching a supermajority position--one [Gallup poll](https://substack.com/redirect/89058c9d-f496-462a-b821-470410787d4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) last month found Americans disapprove of Israel's actions in Gaza nearly two-to-one. And those numbers will likely skew even further in the context of Platner's Maine-first framing; as he said in a recent interview, "None of this stuff benefits working-class Americans.... Nothing in Sullivan, Maine, is going to improve because of our funding of a genocide."
As a combat veteran, Platner can also effectively fit this into his larger message of "no more endless wars." These are all extremely advantageous fights to pick with Collins, a longtime AIPAC champion--fights that Mills likely can't, or wouldn't, engage in.
Finally, Platner's position as an outsider gives him one more advantage: In addition to running against Trump and the GOP, he can also credibly run against everything people dislike about the Democratic Party. One of Trump's greatest strengths as a candidate in 2016 was that, by mercilessly trashing the unpopular failures of the Bush administration, he was able to run with little of the Republican Party's long-standing baggage (just all the new baggage he brought himself).
Today, the national Democratic Party's brand is similarly in the toilet. Longtime politicians like Mills will have trouble separating themselves from that brand, because doing so requires loudly and frequently calling out the failures of the Democratic establishment--something that's nearly impossible for members of that establishment to pull off. Platner, fortunately, feels no such compunction--his fourth ever [post](https://substack.com/redirect/a87721d3-279a-40d7-9960-bfb361c5572c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on X was the relatable complaint, "Nothing pisses me off more than getting a fundraising text from Democrats talking about how they're fighting fascism.... Because it's such bullshit. We're not idiots. Everyone knows most of them aren't doing jack shit right now to fight back." With statements like this, Platner can demonstrate his independence from an unpopular national party and appeal to independent voters in a way Mills simply can't.
Control of the Senate may come down to whether Democrats can field a candidate in Maine who can take out Collins. This is no easy task, and it has not been--and perhaps cannot be--achieved with a politics of bland centrism that refuses to name enemies for fear of alienating elite donors. Platner's campaign is the opposite of this failed approach. His profile, biography, and already clear talent as a communicator situate him to channel the populist frustrations being expressed by Americans across the political spectrum. This guy is the real deal, and rather than continue pushing for a worse candidate to enter the race, Democrats should thank their lucky stars that a figure like Platner has stepped up and unite to build the working-class movement necessary to defeat Collins.
