name: America Fitzpatrick, LCV
subject: DEVASTATING cuts to public lands — we need your help to stop them.
body:
Help keep our nationwide campaign for public lands on the road.

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTI4ODA2NjAS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjI4MDUzNDc1MQS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
|
* * *
---
| | | | [**_PROTECT PUBLIC LANDS! Renew your LCV membership for only $5 to help us keep up the pressure to protect our nation’s most cherished landscapes >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | Peter — fewer park rangers, shuttered programs, and crumbling infrastructure in our nation’s most cherished landscapes.
---
| | These are the consequences of Congressional Republicans’ proposed budget cuts to our public lands.
---
| | I’m reaching out from the road, where my team is rallying support for public lands in a major new initiative with our state affiliates in the Conservation Voters Movement. From Colorado’s rugged mountain peaks to Maine’s historic coastal trails, folks from all over are joining us for hikes, campouts, demonstrations, and town halls to speak out for our public lands and against the sell-off.
---
| | Each and every one of these places is at serious risk — and we need your help: In**just days, Congress will return from recess and could vote on bills that would slash** _**billions**_**in funding from public land agencies like the National Park Service. Trump has also proposed slashing National Park operations by** _**nearly 40%, the biggest cut in history.**_
---
| | Peter, we need your support right now to keep this campaign on the move — from Mt. Hood National Forest in Oregon to the Grand Canyon in Arizona, to the forests and coastlines of Acadia in Maine to Chuckwalla National Monument in the California desert, and beyond.
---
| | [**_Will you renew your LCV membership for just $5 to support public lands and fuel my team’s work to build grassroots pressure Congress can’t ignore ahead of their September 30 budget deadline?_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/4L4XBd0-)
---
| | TIMING IS CRITICAL. Congress is about to return to Washington, D.C. — and is set to take major votes that will decide funding levels for forest and park rangers and other key staff who steward our public lands. _We have to raise the pressure while there’s still time. _
---
| | | [ RENEW YOUR MEMBERSHIP >> ](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/KybpT-)
---
| | The stakes for Congress’ September 30 budget deadline are sky-high, Peter. If we don’t mobilize as many people as possible to advocate for public lands, we could be facing:
* **The most drastic cuts to the National Park Service in history** , as Trump has proposed slashing $1.2 billion from the National Park Service — nearly 40 percent of its operating budget. These reckless cuts will make our national parks less accessible and less safe for the public by shuttering critical visitor services, halting maintenance projects, and ending cultural programs.
* **More staffing shortages at national parks** , stretching the staff who remain after mass DOGE firings, layoffs, and hiring freezes even thinner, and leaving ticket booths unmanned, visitor services in shambles, and critical infrastructure upkeep to fall by the wayside.
* **An uncertain future for public lands’ wildlife and ecosystems** as Congress could FURTHER cut or cancel critical projects like habitat restoration, wildfire prevention, and invasive species management, threatening biodiversity and the long-term health and survival of public lands.

---
| | This is already happening and it could get even worse. At Montana’s Glacier National Park, staff cuts and hiring freezes have left the park’s staff in survival mode, with their infrastructure deteriorating, emergency response compromised, and morale collapsing after losing a quarter of their workforce.
---
| | Our campaign is fighting back, bringing people together within local communities to defend the lands and waters that belong to all of us. Together, we can win this fight. But we need your help, Peter.
---
| | [**_Join us by renewing your membership for only $5 today. Together, we can keep public lands in public hands >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/vNR6fE-)
---
| | In solidarity, America Fitzpatrick
LCV Conservation Program Director
League of Conservation Voters
---
| | |
* * *
---
| | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If this isn't the best email address at which to reach you,[ _update your contact information_](https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/ContactInformation?spMailingID=12880660&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjI4MDUzNDc1MQS2&spReportId=MjI4MDUzNDc1MQS2) _._ [_Click here to unsubscribe_](https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/Unsubscribe?spMailingID=12880660&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjI4MDUzNDc1MQS2&spReportId=MjI4MDUzNDc1MQS2) from our supporter list. [_Send us any comments, criticisms, or feedback here_](mailto:feedback@lcv.org?subject=) , or just reply to this email! Thanks for your support.
**740 15th St NW, Suite 700**
**Washington, DC 20005**
**202-785-8683**

I subsequently served as a county supervisor and as Vice President of the Navajo Nation before being elected President of the Navajo Nation in 2019. I’m proud of my record of public service, leading the effort to save lives during COVID, and making major investments in clean water in Northern Arizona.

I’m running to deliver generational change, because we owe it to our children and grandchildren to leave them a future better than the one we inherited. Unfortunately, Eli Crane isn’t interested in improving the lives of our neighbors. His votes to cut healthcare and food assistance from our most vulnerable populations might go over well in the fancy suburb where Crane lives, but out here in rural Arizona, that dog won’t hunt.

I’m ready to show up in Congress as a champion for rural Arizona, but I need your support. Our district faces real challenges: from the rising costs of gas, food, childcare, and housing to a lack of accountability in Washington. We need a representative in Congress who’s focused on the issues here in Arizona — not the partisan squabbles of DC. Dear Friend,In recent years, there has been a noticeable shift among young Americans who increasingly favor socialism over capitalism. This trend raises a critical question: do they fully understand these two systems' historical contexts and real-world outcomes?To address this, we have created a new eBook, The History of Socialism and Capitalism, authored by two of the most prominent voices in today’s political discourse, Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson.This new eBook offers a deep dive into the origins, development, and impacts of socialism and capitalism. Each scholar presents an in-depth analysis through two different lenses. It’s hard to overstate the relevance of this eBook in today’s policy debates, where radical proposals are gaining traction. Understanding the historical and practical implications of socialism and capitalism is crucial for making informed decisions about our economic and political future. The insights provided by Ferguson and Hanson will equip you with the knowledge to critically evaluate these competing ideologies and their potential impact on society.Don’t miss this opportunity to enhance your understanding of these pivotal economic systems. body:
you probably have a lot of unread emails, but I hope you’ll open this one
| If your email inbox looks anything like mine, you’ve probably got a bunch of unopened emails from campaigns asking for help before the end-of-month this weekend.

So, yes, I know emails like this get to be pretty annoying. But I hope you’ll take a moment to let me explain why our campaign here in New Jersey really does need your support:

**1) We’re one of only two governor’s races that will be decided in 2025.** The election is just over two months away. “Fall short of our goal but hope to make up for it later” isn’t an option right now— because there is no “later” for us. Either we get the resources to get our message out on TV, online, and in person starting immediately, or we don’t.

**2) Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans are going to do everything they can to defeat me in this race.** Trump has already endorsed my opponent, Jack Ciattarelli, and led a rally for him — meaning MAGA money from all over the country is going to pour into Ciattarelli’s campaign. Not to mention, Ciattarelli’s being supported by a MAGA super PAC that’s pouring millions of dollars into negative ads that make one false assertion after another about my record and my character.

**3) Polls show what was already a close race getting even tighter.** Ciattarelli’s super PAC has been attacking me relentlessly for weeks, and it’s clearly having an impact. These polls also show that over 10% of voters are still undecided — so if we don’t get our message out to them before Ciattarelli does, losing doesn’t just become a risk. It becomes a likelihood. [The end-of-month is coming up on Sunday, and it’s so important that we are on track to hit our August fundraising goals. If you could split a donation between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project before the weekend to help us catch up to our goal, I would be extremely thankful →](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/93375?t=6&akid=21018%2E878179%2Epy9iBd) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Mikie Sherrill and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/93376?t=7&akid=21018%2E878179%2Epy9iBd)

Team, **Republicans just launched a new wave of attacks against me.** I’m not new to attacks like this, and I’m not backing down. But there’s only one reason why they keep attacking me: **They’re scared.** They’re coming after the progress we’ve made in Michigan because they know it stands in direct contrast to their extreme agenda. We’ve protected and expanded abortion rights. We’ve grown Michigan’s economy from the middle out and the bottom up — not just for the wealthy few. And we’ve _always_ put hardworking Michiganders first. Our movement is strong, and our record is proof that progress is possible. That terrifies them, and it’s what national Republicans and their billionaire donors are desperate to undo. Since launching Fight Like Hell PAC, we’ve brought together a nationwide coalition fighting every day to stop Republican extremism. But as they double down on their attacks, this work is more urgent than ever. So let them spend their billionaire dollars. ### Amped Up Rundown: Guest Olivia Troye, Frmr Mike Pence National Security Advisor, Quit in Protes
Today's show was a reminder of just how fragile democracy and national security are under Trump 2.0.
I was joined by Olivia Troye, former homeland security and counterterrorism adviser to Mike Pence, who left the GOP after refusing to go along with Trump's Putin-fondling agenda. And my always intrepid co-host, former-Emmy-Award-winning MSNBC and CNN news anchor, David Shuster.
Both brilliant with keen senses of humor, so we were able to talk about deadly serious issues while also finding time to enjoy our conversation. _Together, we walked through the chaos unraveling around us in real time._
**Trump & Putin in Alaska: The Theatrics of Capitulation**
We opened with the so-called "summit" in Alaska. Olivia was blunt: it was pure theater. [Putin dictated the terms](https://substack.com/redirect/a9a81f39-43e8-40a0-8e35-b4810bf6c38b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Trump played along like the ding-dong he is and Ukraine once again came out the loser.
Were these theatrics designed to distract from the Epstein files? Quite possibly. [What's clear is that Trump is in over his head](https://substack.com/redirect/d31967d2-3f37-412b-adaf-05337cfd0f47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- or worse, working in cahoots. And yes, [he once again confused Alaska for Russia](https://substack.com/redirect/5b0b1c65-cf37-4955-97da-8a3fd6cbe1f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which would be funny if the stakes weren't so deadly serious.
**Domestic Terror, Guns, and Russia 's Shadow**
We then turned to the latest mass shooting. C[liff pointed out the grotesque irony: the children killed were literally praying](https://substack.com/redirect/72b41523-4895-4f7b-85dc-648ed6553cca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- making a mockery of the "thoughts and prayers" crowd. The shooter had Russian inscriptions on his gun.
Olivia reminded us that adversaries like Russia and China thrive on our dysfunction, and [with Tulsi Gabbard now running U.S. intelligence](https://substack.com/redirect/b6b5cbf4-5808-4c83-910d-27f55260ba0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the Five Eyes allies are rightly alarmed. Cutting off intel sharing before a Putin summit? That's not just Trumpian incompetence, it feels a lot like betrayal--because it is.

**Greenland Obsession & Rogue Ops**
Yes, Greenland is back. Trump's obsession--part real estate delusion, part resource grab--has now metastasized into covert ops _against an ally_. Olivia explained how Gabbard ramped up intel collection on Greenland's independence movement, [while Trump loyalists are reportedly running amok on the ground](https://substack.com/redirect/51d8e157-7f0a-44c6-ac26-777622d9a544?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Denmark, a NATO ally, is furious. Imagine if Denmark encouraged Texas to secede. **We 'd call it an act of war.** Yet Trump is doing this to an ally, weakening NATO, handing an opening to Putin and turning the U.S. into the rogue actor we used to condemn.
**FEMA Gutted Ahead of Hurricane Season**
>From there, we dug into FEMA. More than 180 employees of the agency wrote a warning letter to Congress that the agency's being gutted. And...as Trump is a fascist, instead of learning from this, instead they've been sidelined, even suspended, for speaking up. [Real lives don't matter to Trump. Just optics.](https://substack.com/redirect/0d03facb-7b1b-493d-be09-1721e99234e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_FEMA staff compared what 's coming to another_ _Katrina-level disaster._ Two of the whistleblowers were literally in the middle of flood response in Texas when Trump's hacks **fired** **them**. As Olivia put it: these aren't partisans. These are Americans begging for help so they can save lives. And yet, FEMA is being dismantled in real time.

**The Bigger Picture: Authoritarian Control**
Cliff raised the looming danger:[ Trump's push to deploy the National Guard in 19 states isn't just about "crime."](https://substack.com/redirect/7d42c83b-4608-40ed-baf4-93f18652e535?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) It's about creating fear, militarizing polling places, and setting the stage for martial law. Olivia confirmed this was a live discussion in 2020 -- Trump wanted the Insurrection Act then, and his cronies like Stephen Miller still want it now. The danger is normalization: if people get used to seeing troops in the streets, [they won't notice when martial law becomes permanent](https://substack.com/redirect/32da4e3b-377d-4cd7-a0e8-9288b13aee61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* * *
**Bottom line:**
Trump's chaos isn't random. It's strategy. Wreck FEMA, side with Putin, undermine NATO, send troops into American cities -- all of it points in one direction: authoritarian control.
Olivia Troye's insider perspective made one thing clear: the guardrails are gone. What used to be unthinkable now occurs daily. And unless we fight back, it's only going to get worse. So fight back, and fight back ferociously, we must!
Stay Amped,
Cliff

**The freedom to rise, the freedom to learn, the freedom from violence, and the freedom to govern ourselves.**
Friend, I believe that every American is entitled to those four fundamental freedoms. Those values are what have guided my work in public service.
Here's how we can achieve these freedoms right here in Colorado:
By ensuring Colorado families can afford healthcare, childcare, and housing; by fighting childhood poverty; and by building an economy that works for everyone, not just those at the top, **_we can achieve the freedom to rise._**
By modernizing our education system to set our kids up for success, no matter what zip code they are born into, and paying our educators what they deserve, **_we can achieve the freedom to learn._**
By partnering with local law enforcement and communities to keep Coloradans safe, fighting the opioid epidemic, and combating the extremism that flourishes on social media,**_we can achieve freedom from violence._**
By protecting Coloradans' voting rights, keeping the government out of our bedrooms and doctors' offices, and reforming our electoral system so the people, not dark money, have the most power, **_we can achieve the freedom to govern ourselves._**
Achieving these goals in the political climate we are living through right now may feel impossible, but I know fighting for what is fundamental will always be worth it.
_That's why I'm running for Governor. Working together, right here at home, we can truly achieve these fundamental freedoms and provide the rest of the country with the hopeful and optimistic vision we desperately need._
**[Friend, I can't and wouldn't want to do this without you by our side. Thank you,
Michael

Hey folks,
We just wrapped a powerful bonus edition of _Endless Urgency_ with **Cameron Kasky** from The Bulwark Network--and wow, it's a must-watch. Cameron and I dove into how Gen Z, especially young men, are feeling about Trump's second term, and what Democrats are getting wrong about winning them back. It's honest, it's raw, and it's essential viewing for anyone trying to make sense of 2025 politics.
Here's what we covered:
* **[00:01:08]** Cameron joins from NYC and reflects on life in Parkland, FL--how his hometown's isolation and tragedy shaped his political journey.
* **[00:03:00]** Cameron breaks down why Gen Z men were drawn to Trump in 2024--and why it had more to do with anger and alienation than actual support.
* **[00:07:00]** We unpack how social media algorithms radicalized young men by feeding them fear and resentment--and how that still drives political attitudes today.
* **[00:13:01]** Zoran Mamdani's stunning NYC victory: how he beat the establishment by actually offering voters something real--and what Democrats must learn from it.
* **[00:29:00]** We talk strategy: why reaching non-voters matters more than pandering to centrists, and how bold, authentic messaging could actually win again.

If you care about reaching young voters, fighting back against rising authoritarianism, and building a Democratic Party that actually delivers for people, this episode is essential. The stakes couldn't be higher--and we don't have time for half-measures.

---
Friend,
---
Believe me, writing this letter was not my first choice...
---
_As a matter of fact, it’s my _last_ _resort_. _
---
**You see, I’m writing to you as a man who’s run out of time, resources, and options ahead of the TRIAL OF MY LIFE.**
---
**A Democrat Attorney General is making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
---
And so, today, I’m not reaching out as America’s Mayor, not as a former prosecutor, not even as President Trump’s former attorney, but as a grandfather and a patriot who’s staring down a 20-year prison sentence for doing what I believed – _and KNOW_ – was RIGHT.
---
The Democrats and their Deep State goons think they’ve finally got me. They’ve left me with no escape, no lifeline – **especially after they’ve already STRIPPED me of my law licenses!**
---
_No viable pardon from the President.
No protection.
No cavalry coming over the hill.
_
---
But even though the most powerful man in the country legally cannot step in to save me, the most powerful _force_ absolutely can: _THE AMERICAN PEOPLE_.
---
So, with my back against the wall, I’m turning to the one thing that can save me:**_the collective voices of MILLIONS of patriots like _YOU_._**
---
My mugshot was entered under booking #2313757, so my goal is for 2,313,757 patriots to sign my official petition — [**“THE PEOPLE’S PARDON OF RUDY GIULIANI”**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=0934ac835c634c0da2b8401523e38b26&_e=UV_8tUHBEzFvORaXRvkdFJQgO8XWzUUYuCTI-LwbUQPtMJ5xrKdHawaiTsGGEiL8e_jpb6uzsMDv09hcP-XXed3YT6yPRYbaWBpUeY6t7jFDTUBBazCpKtBcGx2UuP09B569L5_aQ5-8nlV1Q-sSBg4gjM1xJqJnH-B6R5CjZOAQ_eUd-5bPuY5h7LRrNcHWW5AUEoxzQsljD2KoqJ1CIOTeTfVuBV9YpNi2CZHPSzQYoCMDbuzYA8nwdOeRgBwJBTl9G_Sf4EyruUmTN0mr38z4Lb8Bg80X8C36pzpBLNJ-lMlLUtoTISw285xtX40eGsQ9lMDDX03S3S_SDqu5IjzG-y3RuIcbCC_mxT7O9x6FBuIgTQmP_2KeNrXKu6ktptYXxginyYHx4pfqpmspi0XSgLpZS6S0qeI-ZgcE9pP0k-pNokJx1V6KTfhi42awvHk-a-J_5BRDET-lrko2EmVAk4bYNNYMHIJLMYYxMTmexSkLv5sp9Du_QWB5xW4IcrzHzMLpr_f_SuxHupf3FfrFhs-81YeHXXzKxL8eQloy4NOeiXjmrg7jSjWSQcjzCNV-OcS4kqXqEU6zyracYfxs6nYtK1Y_sxFGA-qWk9KqkUuG7E3aS80Zph1a06SHdS_UHiHyskPJUBo9MFGskA%3D%3D)— calling for my freedom and to DROP ALL CHARGES.
---

Peter,

I want to start this email by saying how grateful I am for this team. Time and again, you have supported this campaign, and you have helped me continue the incredible work we’re doing in Congress for Washington’s 8th District.

But, I also need to level with you. We’re headed into the end of summer, and, while we thought we might beat the dreaded “ _summer slump,”_ **our fundraising slowed a bit these past two weeks.** We’re falling behind on our goal, with only 4 short days to turn things around.

I know I say every campaign is important, but that’s because they are. This is still a purple district, meaning it’s not a safe Democratic seat. When we flipped this seat back in 2018, we flipped it blue for the first time in its history—and it’s been a fight to hold it every two years. And now, what we’re seeing from our nation’s capital - and Republican gerrymandering efforts—makes it even more crucial that we keep this seat blue.

| | Dear Fellow Patriot,**Did Barack Obama commit treason when he launched a multi-front campaign to destroy Donald Trump, his allies, and cripple his incoming Administration?** My answer is “Yes” because I was personally and professionally destroyed by them.Barack Obama along with Hillary Clinton, Susan Rice, James Comey, and other power-hungry radicals concocted this scheme from inside the White House.But the real conspiracy wasn’t just behind closed doors.Everyone was in on it – especially and most dangerously the mainstream media. I’m talking about 24/7 hit pieces. The never-ending barrage of mysterious leaks. Their conspiracy was made possible by collaborators inside the FBI like James Comey and the House Intelligence Committee like Adam Schiff who lied to your face that they had evidence to “get” Trump.This is why I’ve partnered with my friends at the American Media Council to make sure we can reshape the media landscape before the next hoax can destroy our country. **[Today, I’m asking you to join me in supporting their critical mission.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=34c3a4c08ef74adab67072213031dabd&_e=_TYbCXnnnKe9KptXaRqmRv9hQZjq_AMZYdzRapddaggpMIG6KoKi51F1eBF2g6fk5Y2mx-gEvVR6aem4p1EwQ6m_xtUK73X80StemHelPvdQGl7cECH8deB81qj5ZUov-WglpR0Hfe08aSAjFZqz9908LBRUolm37BElZij84hw36z1TzNR85q-bzknmTqLsbpbAVBzuJtOvK0e0qStPiRrsYdh1aG0z_jEY2-3LBQxTWw9cg-bIIJZdl9F8zctlcxRit4q2fgbDS2w6NMV1cVTFM_z7j2tBWymvTOh6cHbLcrmFKAfr1CLDz29mQBl4ChBe1Ee_RTgIXPvlPILGxJ_NlJYGDMDy5Oh-uytsb_Wsa1F5WoG8B-BqTZ1uM94xwmvneRZaMu-6HeYZQ5DlZs-wMcX04qV3315iN5p7Q82AZr797gUfFzWMSsen3p6Jb1QYWuDUiUmQGqtxY_8DjkiQJU36PaWwAX1RVsxDkF8M91fttZjRTKjdFeNOyos9ldpRBKBbBEKbIxw8ZQcErdr8-Alp8f6nT8AaX64aqK2DHspfcVEtbEbS5HKWW1qUkBJqYXrZzD3bo2KFn7-3pKmbp-jtYj7AlZXddPzDAtkYGLvnJEmTrHudYGGOZXukW5HO6JHkXRv50HTK_uXB0gbd8qVt33ymLD9eEBSBW6g9Gsk3NP3_Cwmc-QrtxCKYFiX7mhnpT702WYie-hE1kiTvfgtd_9-EH6Lgv46fWMHjfga49YJR4CghmZi_32mIrIdQHbsW1-UW9xW141wjmg%3D%3D)** It’s a mission I care deeply about because I was the target of the Fake News’ lies.Here’s the truth: Obama and Hillary didn’t have a lick of evidence when they cooked up this hoax. Here’s the _disturbing_ truth: they didn’t need any.They could make up whatever they wanted to and feed it to the mainstream media monster. That’s exactly what they did.Let me explain:
---
1. They planted fake evidence in the mainstream media.

2. The mainstream media ran them as if they were fact.

3. The mainstream media's coverage was cited as proof the fake evidence was real.

Earlier this year, First Selectman Gerber passed away due to complications of brain surgery.
The process to fill this unforeseen vacancy first gives the Board of Selectmen an opportunity to appoint a successor within Fairfield's Charter within 30-days. After the 30 day period, **which has passed** , Connecticut State Law takes over and provides that a small group of party insiders choose the next leader of Fairfield which is against the democratic principles that we stand for.

We started with petitions to get on the ballot in 2022. In 2024 we qualified without petitions and went hard at it to win a primary by taking it to the people.
The Mantra that applies to either party when it comes to grassroots efforts - **Parties Do Not Matter, People Do** - and that is the importance of knocking on doors and informing voters (as the papers and rest of media do not want to broadcast elections here in Connecticut).
**The Case for a Special Election - Especially in Fairfield**
To stop party insiders from selecting the next First Selectman, the most un-democratic construct, **YOU THE PEOPLE OF FAIRFIELD** have the right to say **NO** to back-room deals and petition for a special election. This is your right and it is your duty to ensure this happens.

| | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** August 28th, 2025
**NEW POLL: Karrin Taylor Robson Holds Dominant Lead in GOP Primary for AZ Governor** _KTR Leads Biggs 37% - 27%_
**PHOENIX, AZ –** A new survey by [Noble Predictive Insights](https://karrinforarizona.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=473c144f5f100c2eff990c077&id=639a2f0d9d&e=ebfb0fda52) shows Trump-endorsed conservative business leader Karrin Taylor Robson leading Congressman Andy Biggs by **10 points** in the Republican primary for Governor of Arizona. After two years of backyard throwing, my curveballs finally started to well... curve. **The Hickenlooper Curve, we called it.** Then, the guys who used to laugh at the small, skinny kid on the pitching mound started striking out — and I learned one of the greatest lessons about determination, hard work, and perseverance. **Here’s why I’m telling you this: this story is why I remain grounded amid the partisan politics and nonsense happening in our government.** Because with all the chaos and dysfunction in Washington, you need somebody who will roll up their sleeves and get to work.
